verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order (badge, headline, subhead, phone, CTA), but the 'ONLINE ONLY' badge is shrunk to a tiny tag, the subhead leaves 'now.' orphaned on its own line, and a clipped cream circle fragment sits in a dead empty band under the CTA. B fills the strip better and has a bolder headline, but it moves the supporting subhead below the CTA, which breaks reading order, and pushes it into the bottom edge next to the same clipped circle fragment.
